name: Mekaluko
backstory: Child of Mekestros and Aureluko in Gorff; raised alongside drives a caravan up and down the transit..., having heard about Birth Of Darnarika.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Auroboro and Aurebalo now have a child, Aureboro.
Heard that Khaubalo and Mekestros now have a child, Khaubestro.
Heard that Mekestros and Khaubalo now have a child, Khaumestro.
Heard that Mekestros and Khaubalo now have a child, Mekhaubo.
Heard that Aureluko and Mekhaubo now have a child, Mekhaurel.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to Birth Of Dorakus
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with Birth Of Dorakus
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: drives the caravan route on his own schedule now, pays the toll the same way his father always did, has started keeping his own tally of who's overcharged

arc.premise: Word of the new Forliamus betrothal offer travels the road before it reaches Gorff's own square, and Mekaluko wants to be the one who actually confirms whether it's sealed - a settled marriage alliance might finally take the old toll politics off his route for good.
